_comment: Undyed wool felt (Phase08 8.4, RD-P08-5): pressed, matted wool with no weave, the stuff of a hat, a slipper or a craft sheet. Authored at undyed wool's pale oatmeal so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches the dyed colours below it. OPAQUE, very matte, with heavy FUZZ: felt's look is its loose surface fibres. The matted fibres are the article's own normal and roughness.
name: Felt_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: undyed, scoured wool, a pale oatmeal (linear 0.66, 0.63, 0.56; no measured value). IOR 1.55: keratin (as Hair). Roughness ~0.92 in the map: a fibre mat has no smooth face. Fuzz 0.9: the most of any shipped textile (Cotton_Jersey 0.6), because a felt's surface is loose fibre ends.
